content: Probability calibration for trading dashboards: raw LightGBM/XGBoost probabilities are monotone-but-not-calibrated (often compressed toward the middle); presenting them as win probabilities misleads; use CalibratedClassifierCV (isotonic on enough data, sigmoid/Platt otherwise) fitted inside the walk-forward loop, and report reliability diagrams + Brier score alongside; store both raw score and calibrated probability.
